smoke.observation: mean membrane voltage mV in each contiguous 16-neuron partition before action
smoke.action: uniform injected current pA in each partition
smoke.trace_encoding: IEEE754 binary64 hex for all voltage/adaptation/conductance/action/observation values plus spike bits; RNG state SHA256 after each step

limitations: Exploratory adapter qualification only; no predeclared neural goal task or causal dual-control benefit.
COUPLED and CENTRAL execute the same update within one process; no distributed transport or physical cost equivalence proved.
No training, plasticity qualification, criticality claim, PID attribution or real-world safety proof.
Fresh seeds here are public engineering fixtures, not a blinded replication cohort.
